note: Neon League items, batch 1 of 5 (DC-N1): the unlock spine. Two boss balls, the boss pin, the champion's Charm and the title's ball modification, written and landed together by E18-C15 with Bumper Guard (E17-D04). Oilskin Ball uses E18-C14's oil hold; the others use existing rule pieces. Each is a rival's or the title's reward: they land as initial items, and E22-L02 assigns their gates (named in each pool note and in content/leagues/neon.json) when it registers them, as E22-L01 did for House. Amounts and prices are provisional (E24).

design.trigger: Rolls on every lane as if it were House Oil: Long Oil and Two-Tone change nothing for it. It hooks 1.3 times as far as the House Ball. Boss rules still apply.
design.pool: Shop ball slot. It is Slick's first-clear reward: initial until E22-L02 registers gate.slick_cleared and assigns it, as the House rewards were.
design.presentation_needs: A slick, beaded surface that reads at lane distance; on Long Oil or Two-Tone a short cue shows the oil leaving it untouched.

design.trigger: Thrown with this ball, a roll gives +3 Mult for each roll in the frame graded sweet or perfect. It hooks a quarter as far as the House Ball.
design.pool: Shop ball slot. It is Laser Lena's first-clear reward: initial until E22-L02 registers gate.laser_lena_cleared and assigns it, as the House rewards were.
design.presentation_needs: A thin beam line along its path on a sweet or perfect release; the count of accurate rolls shows in the explanation.

design.trigger: When it is knocked down it gives +20 Value for each roll in the frame graded sweet or perfect; nothing if no roll was.
design.pool: Shop pin slot. It is DJ Flicker's first-clear reward: initial until E22-L02 registers gate.dj_flicker_cleared and assigns it, as the House rewards were.
design.presentation_needs: A pin with a level-meter band that lights one or two bars with the frame's accurate rolls; dark on a clean or missed frame.

design.trigger: In a frame with a curved roll, +4 Mult for each roll graded sweet or perfect. A straight frame, or no accurate roll, gives nothing.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot. It is the Neon Champion's first-clear reward: initial until E22-L02 registers gate.neon_champion_cleared and assigns it, as the House rewards were.
design.presentation_needs: A tube sign that lights one or two letters with the accurate rolls of a curved frame; unlit otherwise.

design.trigger: Attached to one ball card: when a roll thrown with that card makes a curved strike, ×1.5 Mult. Nothing on a spare, an open frame or a straight strike.
design.pool: Shop modification slot from Division 2. It is the Neon League title's reward: initial until E22-L02 registers gate.neon_champion and assigns it, as the House rewards were. One modification per ball.
design.presentation_needs: A badge on the host card and a violet glow on the host in play that flares on a curved strike; the host's own marking stays readable.
